raw_source.title: EkvahLabs is hiring Team Lead / Advisor to CTO
raw_source.body:
**Full job description**

Kitchener, Ontario N2G 1A6, CA  · remote · Full-time

**Compensation**

$220,000–$250,000 + 0.5%–1% equity

**About the Company**

Our client is a software technology company developing scalable Marketplace and SaaS platforms powered by AI and blockchain technologies, enabling businesses to automate operations, optimize customer experiences, and build secure digital ecosystems across fintech, e-commerce, healthcare, logistics, and enterprise solutions. It has doubled ARR in the first half of the year and is targeting another 2x in the second half. The team is split between Europe and Canada.

**Founded** 2021 11–50 people (Seed)  **Industry:** AI / Cloud / Blockchain Services

**The Role**

Lead the day-to-day running of a 28 - person engineering team (which includes the CTO) as a hands-on tech lead - owning architecture, prioritization, and engineering process while continuing to write code.
Tech stack: Full-stack applications, cloud / software architecture, LLMs.

**Requirements**

Remote, Monday–Friday, 09:00 AM ~ 06:00 PM
6+ years of engineering experience, most recently as a staff engineer, tech lead, or engineering manager
Hands-on engineering-team management experience
Full-stack and cloud/software-architecture depth, including LLMs
Conversational- or voice- AI company experience (a strong plus)

**Nice to Haves**

Startup pedigree at a high-caliber fintech or developer-tools company
Previous tech-lead or engineering-management experience at a cloud-service companies
CTO-level thinking paired with hands-on execution

**Why Join**

A CTO - track role: framed as a CTO - like next hire to take day-to-day engineering leadership off the CTO - described as one of the most important hires of the year
High-growth traction: doubled ARR in H1 and targeting another 2x in H2
Ownership plus hands-on: final say on prioritization and architecture while still contributing code 20–30% of the time

**Details**

Location - Kitchener, Ontario N2G 1A6, CA 
Work policy - Remote, Monday ~ Friday, 09:00 AM ~ 06:00 PM
Compensation - $220,000 ~ $250,000 + 0.5% ~ 1% equity
Employment type - Remote

**Contact me**
Email: hello@ekvahlabs.com
Telegram: @Brightete
